subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should Control UI ship a core Gateway-backed editable dictation workflow once this PR is rebased, proven, and the patch blockers are fixed?
rationale: The implementation adds a new browser microphone capture path and an authenticated Gateway audio RPC that invokes configured STT providers or local CLI transcription, so maintainer intent is needed for the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Accept after fixes and proof
options.body: Land the Gateway-backed editable dictation direction after the branch is rebased, the alert/docs-map defects are fixed, and redacted real behavior proof shows recording, transcription, and draft insertion.

options.title: Keep the issue but request a fresh branch
options.body: If rebasing this branch onto the new chat architecture would discard most of it, keep the canonical issue open and ask for a narrower replacement PR.

options.title: Pause core dictation
options.body: Defer core Control UI dictation until maintainers settle the broader WebChat voice and provider-routing direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after fixes and proof
recommendation.body: Land the Gateway-backed editable dictation direction after the branch is rebased, the alert/docs-map defects are fixed, and redacted real behavior proof shows recording, transcription, and draft insertion.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has both prior server-side dictation history and the current UI refactor history for the affected chat surface.
